name: Barbell Pin Press
steps: Rest the bar on level safety pins above chest height and lie beneath it on the bench with your feet planted.
Grip the bar, set your shoulders against the pad and build tension without lifting it.
Press the bar forcefully upward off the pins until your arms extend fully over your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly back onto the pins, letting both ends settle evenly before starting the next repetition.
tips: Pause to a complete dead stop on the pins without bouncing the bar upward.
Keep your upper back tight during the pause so your shoulder blades do not lose position.
